components.text:
This ritual attacks mobs within its damage zone and puts the harvested $(blood)Blood$() into a nearby Blood Altar. Put a Blood Orb in the Altar, maybe add a few Runes of Sacrifice, and you have a fantastic passive $(blood)LP$() generator. Tier 0, costs $(blood)40,000 LP$() to activate.
Use a Ritual Diviner [Dusk] for easier construction.
The ritual can only link to one altar at a time. Mobs will still drop their normal, non-player-kill drops.
